title: Neural Networks and Large Language Models
introduction: Neural networks transform inputs through connected layers, while large language models use this approach to predict language tokens.
learningOutcomes: Give a simple description of a neural network.
Identify important limitations of generated content.

activities.question: What is a token in a large language model?
options: A unit of text processed by the model
A guarantee that a statement is true
A physical part of the computer
activities.explanation: Text is divided into tokens, which may be words, parts of words, punctuation or other text units.

activities.question: A fluent answer from a language model is guaranteed to be factually correct.
activities.explanation: The model generates plausible token sequences and can produce confident but incorrect information.

activities.question: A language model repeatedly predicts the next ___ when generating a response.
activities.explanation: Generation proceeds by predicting a token, adding it to the context and predicting again.
